records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: CRESUM fitness app Male technique artwork, one paired source sheet for later exact square crops.
Primary request: Generate START and FINISH of the seated chest-supported reverse pec deck / machine rear deltoid fly TOGETHER in ONE image. Two equal square panels side by side on a 2:1 landscape sheet: LEFT START, RIGHT FINISH. No divider and no text.

Input images and roles:
1. CRESUM Male Master five-view sheet: identity, adult proportions, natural skin, hair and approved blue-gray outfit only.
2. Official Life Fitness Insignia SS-FLY product photo: the actual machine's structure, overhead pivots, descending lever arms, dual handles, chest pad, seat and floor supports. This shows an empty machine, not the rear-delt exercise setup.
3. Official SS-FLY owner's manual exercise page: use the REAR DELTOID setup and the lower-right top-view motion diagram, not the pectoral-fly setup or the colored anatomy illustrations. Its rear-deltoid instruction specifies facing the pad, inside HORIZONTAL handles, arms parallel to floor and slightly bent elbows.
4. Frozen CRESUM equipment style reference: ONLY satin silver-gray metal, graphite stack shrouds, dark matte upholstery/grips, soft lighting and premium semi-realistic 3D finish. Do not copy its assisted-pull-up machine, kneeling posture or handles.

Scene/backdrop: clean white seamless studio, soft neutral light, light natural grounding/contact shadows.
Subject: the SAME recognizable clean-shaven young adult Male Master in BOTH panels, short brown hair, athletic natural adult build. Fitted muted blue-gray T-shirt, dark gray shorts, visible normal-length white athletic socks, light-gray training shoes, all unbranded. Preserve fine consistent skin and fabric; no exaggerated muscles or waxy skin.

Machine/setup: a realistic SS-FLY-type selectorized pec-fly/rear-delt station. Fixed stack tower, base, upright pad and seat, upper support/crosshead, two overhead vertical-axis pivots, two rigid moving lever assemblies descending to the dual handles. Retain plausible manufacturer geometry and clearances; change its frame finish to CRESUM satin silver-gray while retaining graphite shrouds and dark matte pads. Remove ALL manufacturer lettering, decals, numbers, logos and instructional placards: clean blank surfaces. Do not invent cables attached to the hands, loose D-handles, resistance bands, elbow pads or a different machine.
The athlete sits astride the seat FACING the upright pad and stack, chest supported against the front pad, upright neutral torso, hips remain seated, neck relaxed, gaze forward. Both feet planted naturally on the floor beside the base. Seat height places the working arms approximately horizontal at shoulder level. Both hands wrap the INSIDE HORIZONTAL grip segments of the two lever handles, thumbs and fingers naturally closed around them, wrists aligned. The outside vertical chest-fly grips remain unused.

LEFT START: both working arms reach forward toward the machine, at shoulder height, hands separated comfortably at roughly shoulder width. Elbows retain a small soft bend. The machine's two moving arms are set in the narrow forward rear-delt starting configuration. Chest stays on the pad; do not cross the arms.
RIGHT FINISH: spread both arms out sideways in a broad controlled arc to approximately the shoulder line, retaining the same small elbow bend and the SAME horizontal handle grip. No pulling behind the torso, no elbow-flexion row, no shrugging, no chest lift. The two RIGID lever assemblies rotate about their overhead pivots to follow the hands; their lengths and handle shapes remain the same.

Composition/framing: SAME fixed rear three-quarter viewpoint in both panels, looking slightly from the athlete's right and behind, so both arms' phase difference, hand/handle contacts, the pad contact, seat, legs and feet are readable. Same camera elevation, perspective, machine anchoring and UNIFORM athlete/machine scale in both squares. The fixed machine structure is identical; ONLY the moving lever arms and athlete's arms change phase. Choose the LARGEST common uniform scale that fits the complete machine and the full FINISH motion envelope with modest safety clearance around every edge. Do not independently shrink START. Full head, both hands/handles, all moving levers and overhead pivots, both shoes and full floor supports must fit each square. No clipped edges, no giant white margins, no stretched anatomy.

Style/medium: polished premium semi-realistic 3D instructional illustration matching the Master and frozen style. Calm neutral materials, even fine surfaces and restrained metal highlights.
Avoid: text of any kind, labels START/FINISH, titles, arrows, diagram overlays, colored muscle highlights, logos, watermarks, extra people/limbs/hands, floating handles, intersecting body/frame, drift between panels, changed grip, glossy saturated clothing, noisy metal or excessive white space.
records.visualQA: Good identity, proportions, material continuity, full framing and recognizable phase separation. All four contacts use the unused vertical handle segments rather than manufacturer horizontal rear-delt grips. Fixed tower/base in FINISH is shifted left compared with START at a comparable common scale. Targeted repair requested; no user selection, integration or independent acceptance.
